subject: Request: temporary credits to keep weekend integration tests active
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Chu <alan.chu@pulsehealth.com>
Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary credits to keep weekend integration tests active

Hi Alan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. I understand your procurement team has the PO in review and that your integration tests are scheduled for the weekend. To avoid the integration window slipping, we can provision a short, temporary credit allowance so your engineers can complete the testing without interruption.

Proposal: a 72-hour trial credit bundle tied to your account (non-billable, single-use) that keeps the test environment live while the PO clears. We’ll automatically revoke the credits at the end of the window; no charge if PO completes and you accept the invoice.

If that works, I need: 1) a confirmation of the PO number (or procurement contact) and 2) a quick acknowledgment from legal that trial terms are acceptable — I’ve attached the minimal trial_access_terms.pdf for your review.

I’ve copied Camila (solutions engineering) to coordinate the technical handoff. We aim to enable the credits by EOD today if you can confirm.

Best,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0186

Attachments: trial_access_terms.pdf

From: Alan Chu <alan.chu@pulsehealth.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@pulsehealth.com, Jessica Tan <jessica.tan@pulsehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 14:20:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credits to keep weekend integration tests active

Thanks Lukas — appreciate the offer. Procurement is in the middle of a three-approver flow and it looks like final sign-off won’t land until Monday afternoon. If you can provision the credits for Saturday–Monday (72 hours) that would let us run the full regression and smoke tests as planned.

PO number is pending; procurement asked that we include the master services agreement reference and the expected PO ID once issued. I’ve CC’d procure@ so they see the terms.

Quick Q: any limits on which endpoints or models the trial credits apply to? Our integration uses embeddings + chat generation for the assistant.

—Alan
Alan Chu
Senior Engineer, Integrations | PulseHealth
alan.chu@pulsehealth.com

Hi Alan — looping in Karthis (finance) to confirm the operational steps.

Short answers to your questions: 1) The temporary credits are account-level and usable for embeddings and chat generation; we’ll flag the allocation so it cannot be consumed outside the integration test project. 2) We’ll set a 72-hour timer and can disable model variants if you need to limit usage to lower-cost configs.

Process: Karthis, can you approve a one-off 72-hour credit allocation for PulseHealth tied to deal PH-2027-0451? If yes, we’ll schedule it to begin Saturday 08:00 PT and we’ll send Alan the allocation ID.

Alan — if procurement can confirm the PO ID by Monday we’ll convert usage to the paid invoice; otherwise credits will expire automatically.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
